actors: Applicant or submitter of an investment-product application or submission
classification_assumptions: The item submitted is an application or submission concerning an investment product administered by IPD.
The submission date is the date on which the application or submission is made to IPD.
A submission made through e-IP is distinct from one made through another channel.
missing_information: Whether the particular investment product is administered by IPD.
Whether the application or submission was transmitted through e-IP.
Whether any exception to the stated mandatory route applies to the particular submission.

assumptions: The predicate assesses route compliance for a single investment-product application or submission to IPD.
The rule applies on and after 2024-11-30; the circular states that the parallel run ends on 2024-11-29.
Unknown facts remain unresolved and are not treated as true or false.

citations.quote: After the extended period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by the Investment Products Division (IPD)1 must be submitted to IPD via e-IP from 30 November 2024.
Starting 30 November 2024, ie, after the parallel run period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by IPD must be submitted via e-IP.
During this period, the SFC continues to accept applications and submissions via existing channels.

reading.distinction: This is a submission-channel condition triggered by the date and IPD administration status; it does not determine whether an investment product is authorised, licensed, or legally compliant in any broader sense.

facts.meaning: The application or submission concerns an investment product administered by IPD.
facts.name: investment_product_administered_by_ipd

facts.meaning: The date on which the application or submission is made to IPD.
facts.name: submission_date

facts.meaning: The application or submission was transmitted to IPD through e-IP.
facts.name: submitted_via_e_ip

formalization.scope: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The condition is true when an IPD-administered investment-product application or submission made on or after 2024-11-30 was submitted via e-IP; it is false when the triggering facts hold and the submission was not via e-IP. If a fact is unknown, the condition cannot be determined from this formalization.

questions: Does any specific exemption or alternative route apply to this application or submission?
Are the submission date and channel records complete and reliable?
reading.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The mandatory e-IP route condition is satisfied when an application or submission for an IPD-administered investment product is made on or after 30 November 2024 and is submitted via e-IP.
reading.subject: A single application or submission of an investment product administered by IPD

relationships: IPD administers the relevant investment product.
The applicant or submitter sends the application or submission to IPD.
e-IP is the required submission channel from 30 November 2024 after the parallel run.
The submission date determines whether the mandatory route applies.
proposals.temporal_basis: The rule applies from 2024-11-30 onward; the parallel run, during which existing channels were accepted, ended on 2024-11-29.
proposals.unit_of_assessment: One investment-product application or submission to IPD

provenance.transport_retry_policy: NO_APPLICATION_RETRY; CLI transport behavior is external
